name: easytable-mcp
description: easyTable restaurant reservations for Claude — check availability, look up bookings, and create, modify or cancel reservations

ws_port.title: Bridge WebSocket port
ws_port.description: Optional. Override the fetchproxy WebSocket port (default 37149). Leave blank to use it.

fetchproxy_ws_host.title: Bridge bind interface (hosted only)
fetchproxy_ws_host.description: Optional. Bind interface for the bridge, a literal IP only (anything else is ignored); default 127.0.0.1. Keep on loopback — it exists for a hosted child in its own network namespace. Leave blank.

fetchproxy_identity_dir.title: Bridge identity directory (hosted only)
fetchproxy_identity_dir.description: Optional. Where to store the long-term bridge identity keypair, an absolute path only (anything else is ignored); default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/. Exists for a host that runs a separate child per caller. Leave blank.

tools.name: easytable_list_types
tools.description: List the bookable areas/types for a restaurant (e.g. indoor, bar)

tools.name: easytable_list_dates
tools.description: List bookable dates for a restaurant area and party size

tools.name: easytable_list_times
tools.description: List available time slots for a restaurant area, date, and party size

tools.name: easytable_find_bookings
tools.description: Look up a restaurant's existing bookings made with a given mobile number

tools.name: easytable_create_booking
tools.description: Create a restaurant booking (asks you to confirm first — a prompt, or a preview + confirmToken; reads the widget's Turnstile token via the bridge)

tools.name: easytable_modify_booking
tools.description: Modify an existing booking (asks you to confirm first — a prompt, or a preview + confirmToken)

tools.name: easytable_cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel an existing booking (asks you to confirm first — a prompt, or a preview + confirmToken)

tools.name: easytable_healthcheck
tools.description: Check the ContextMint Bridge connection to book.easytable.com
